# Coverage waiver inventory for guard-core-go.
#
# Every entry is a defensive statement that is unreachable as written. The
# gate treats these statements as satisfied and fails on any uncovered
# statement NOT listed here. Genuine tests are preferred over waivers: the
# twin sweep (guardcore/coverage_twin_sweep_test.go and its integration
# half) covers every remaining reachable statement with real inputs.
#
# Statement attribution differs across toolchains (go 1.26 and 1.27 split
# several blocks at different lines), so each proof lists BOTH coordinates:
# the go 1.26 line (CI's toolchain) and the go 1.27 line. Extra entries are
# inert on the toolchain that does not produce them. The proofs are
# restated against the current sources, superseding the PR #39 audit
# coordinates that the feature-port waves (event bus, dynamic rules,
# headers cache, cloud/geo, pattern ledger, PerformanceMonitor) shifted.
#
# Format: <file>:<startLine> per line; comments (#) and blank lines ignored.

# base64decode.go
# findAllStrings stale-match guard: regexp2's FindStringMatchStartingAt
# never reports a match whose Index precedes the requested start, so
# m.Index < pos cannot hold.
guardcore/base64decode.go:51
guardcore/base64decode.go:54
# findAllStrings zero-advance guard: every b64 RE on this path
# (b64SubFloorRE and friends) requires at least one character, so
# m.Length > 0 and next = m.Index + m.Length > pos always.
guardcore/base64decode.go:59
guardcore/base64decode.go:60
# decodeRuns/decodeBase64Candidates ReplaceFunc error returns: a compiled
# regexp2 RE cannot error during replace; the branches are defensive
# hygiene.
guardcore/base64decode.go:235
guardcore/base64decode.go:296
guardcore/base64decode.go:236
guardcore/base64decode.go:297
# buildShortBase64AdditiveView zero-advance guard: shortBase64TokenRE is
# {4,}, so m.Length >= 4 and pos = m.Index + m.Length > m.Index always.
guardcore/base64decode.go:362
guardcore/base64decode.go:363

# the final '/' segment, so the stripped name is never empty.
guardcore/checks_custom.go:131
guardcore/checks_custom.go:141
guardcore/checks_custom.go:132
guardcore/checks_custom.go:142

guardcore/composition.go:106

guardcore/composition.go:108

guardcore/composition.go:111

# geoip.go
# Refresh post-download stat guard: a nil download error means

guardcore/geoip.go:301
# downloadDatabase post-loop return: the loop returns inside the body on

guardcore/geoip.go:364
